units.source_text: 为伐竹会效力的不是僧侣，主要是乡下人。

en.t: The people who served at the bamboo-cutting ceremony were not monks, but mostly country folk.

units.source_text: 十八日就得为伐竹作准备，将雄竹和雌竹各四根，分别横捆在大雄宝殿左右的圆柱上。

en.t: On the eighteenth, preparations had to be made for the bamboo cutting: four male bamboos and four female bamboos were tied horizontally, separately, to the round pillars on the left and right of the main hall.

units.source_text: 雄竹去根留叶，雌竹则留根去叶。

en.t: The male bamboos had their roots removed and their leaves left on, while the female bamboos kept their roots and had their leaves removed.
